name: Ikemen Kakumei ◆ Alice to Koi no Mahou
original_name: イケメン革命◆ アリスと恋の魔法
source:
In 19th century London, a chase after a gentleman curiously resembling a white rabbit leads you to a land where magic trumps reason.
At the center of a struggle between Red and Black armies, 14 Wonderland Ikémen threaten to cast the spell to keep you from returning home— love.

[From [url=https://ikemen-series.com/games/revolution/index.html]English official website[/url]]
translation:
在19世纪的伦敦，追捕一位酷似白兔的绅士，将带你进入魔法战胜理性的土地。
在红黑两军斗争的中心，14个仙境伊克曼威胁要施展咒语，阻止你回家——爱情。

[来自[url=https://ikemen-series.com/games/revolution/index.html]英文官网[/url]]
